1.say: It is Sunday. The weather is bad in Tashkent. Hello, Aziz. What are you doing? I am sitting at home. I am reading a book. Where is Kamola? She is in the kitchen. She is making lunch. And Bobur? Is he playing football? No, he is not. The weather is bad today. It is cold and it is raining. I am wearing a coat and a hat! Are you walking to the park now? No, I am waiting for my friend. We are going to the shop. Look! The sun is here. It is not raining now. Yes! I am walking!
